properties.statement: A dimension is a rational vector over exactly the eight axes m, kg, s, mol, K, A, cd, rad: every axis is one of them, there are eight, and they are distinct.
properties.lean_statement: (∀ a : Esm.Units.Axis, a ∈ Esm.Units.Axis.all) ∧ Esm.Units.Axis.all.length = 8 ∧ Esm.Units.Axis.all.Nodup

properties.statement: The table is flat and there is no SI-prefix mechanism: a single run of identifier characters starting with a letter resolves iff it is a §4.8.1 key exactly as spelled (so nothing composes a prefix with a key and nothing splits a run).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ a : List Char, Esm.Units.IdentRun a → ((∃ u, Esm.Units.resolveChars a = .ok u) ↔ String.ofList a ∈ Esm.Units.keys)

properties.statement: Symbol lookup is exact: a symbol has a table entry iff it is a key exactly as spelled.
The exclusions §4.8.1 lists (ton, t, d, in, yd, foot, feet, mile, miles, mph, …) and prefixed spellings absent from the table (kmolec, nppb, Tm, dam, dg, PW, fs, cm3, s2) do not resolve.
The mixing ratios, fractions, counts and dimensionless spellings carry no dimension (counts are not mol and not cd).
`%` and `percent` are dimensionless at scale exactly 0.01; the counts and `psu` are dimensionless at scale 1.
`C` is the coulomb A·s, with no temperature component.
properties.closed_ok: the spec states this identity about named table entries; it is a fixed fact of the registry, checked exactly

properties.statement: Units under multiplication form an abelian group up to agreement (equal dimension and equal exact scale), and agreement is a congruence for multiplication.
properties.lean_statement: (∀ u v w : Esm.Units.U, ((u.mul v).mul w).Agree (u.mul (v.mul w))) ∧ (∀ u v : Esm.Units.U, (u.mul v).Agree (v.mul u)) ∧ (∀ u : Esm.Units.U, (Esm.Units.U.one.mul u).Agree u) ∧ (∀ u : Esm.Units.U, (u.mul u.inv).Agree Esm.Units.U.one) ∧ (∀ u u' v v' : Esm.Units.U, u.Agree u' → v.Agree v' → (u.mul v).Agree (u'.mul v'))

properties.statement: Rational powers obey the exponent laws exactly: (u^a)^b = u^(ba), u^(a+b) = u^a·u^b, (uv)^q = u^q v^q, u^1 = u, u^0 = 1, and agreement is a congruence for powers.
properties.lean_statement: (∀ (u : Esm.Units.U) (a b : ℚ), ((u.rpow a).rpow b).Agree (u.rpow (b * a))) ∧ (∀ (u : Esm.Units.U) (a b : ℚ), (u.rpow (a + b)).Agree ((u.rpow a).mul (u.rpow b))) ∧ (∀ (u v : Esm.Units.U) (q : ℚ), ((u.mul v).rpow q).Agree ((u.rpow q).mul (v.rpow q))) ∧ (∀ u : Esm.Units.U, (u.rpow 1).Agree u) ∧ (∀ u : Esm.Units.U, (u.rpow 0).Agree Esm.Units.U.one) ∧ (∀ (u u' : Esm.Units.U) (q : ℚ), u.Agree u' → (u.rpow q).Agree (u'.rpow q))

properties.statement: The real value of an exact scale is positive, multiplicative, sends rational powers to real powers, and is equal on agreeing units: composing exact scales is exact.
properties.lean_statement: (∀ s : Esm.Units.Scale, 0 < Esm.Units.Scale.real s) ∧ (∀ s t : Esm.Units.Scale, Esm.Units.Scale.real (s ++ t) = Esm.Units.Scale.real s * Esm.Units.Scale.real t) ∧ (∀ (s : Esm.Units.Scale) (q : ℚ), Esm.Units.Scale.real (Esm.Units.Scale.rpow s q) = Esm.Units.Scale.real s ^ (q : ℝ)) ∧ (∀ u v : Esm.Units.U, u.Agree v → Esm.Units.Scale.real u.scale = Esm.Units.Scale.real v.scale)

properties.statement: The exact (prime-factor) scale of a positive rational determines it: two positive rationals have the same exact scale iff they are equal.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (q r : ℚ), 0 < q → 0 < r → (Esm.Units.Scale.exp (Esm.Units.Scale.ofRat q) = Esm.Units.Scale.exp (Esm.Units.Scale.ofRat r) ↔ q = r)

properties.statement: Multiplying nonzero rationals adds their exact scales.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (q r : ℚ), q ≠ 0 → r ≠ 0 → Esm.Units.Scale.exp (Esm.Units.Scale.ofRat (q * r)) = Esm.Units.Scale.exp (Esm.Units.Scale.ofRat q ++ Esm.Units.Scale.ofRat r)

properties.statement: `*`, `/` and juxtaposition are one precedence level folded left to right: any chain of symbols joined by them parses as the left fold (J/mol*K is (J/mol)*K).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (a : String) (ops : List (Esm.Units.Op × String)), Esm.Units.parse (.sym a :: Esm.Units.opToks ops) = .ok (Esm.Units.foldOps (.sym a) ops)

properties.statement: `^` and `**` bind tighter than `/`: a/b^q parses as a/(b^q), for signed or unsigned numeric exponents.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (a b lit : String) (q : ℚ) (i : Bool) (pw : Esm.Units.Tok), (pw = .caret ∨ pw = .dstar) → Esm.Units.parse [.sym a, .slash, .sym b, pw, .num lit q i] = .ok (.div (.sym a) (.pow (.sym b) q)) ∧ Esm.Units.parse [.sym a, .slash, .sym b, pw, .minus, .num lit q i] = .ok (.div (.sym a) (.pow (.sym b) (-q)))

properties.statement: A parenthesised rational exponent ^(p/q) or ^(-p/q) is the exact rational ±p/q.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (p q : ℕ) (neg : Bool) (lp lq : String) (ts : List Esm.Units.Tok), q ≠ 0 → Esm.Units.pExp (.lp :: (if neg then [Esm.Units.Tok.minus] else []) ++ .num lp (p : ℚ) true :: .slash :: .num lq (q : ℚ) true :: .rp :: ts) = .ok ((if neg then -(p : ℚ) else p) / q, ts)

properties.statement: A numeric atom other than 1 at the head of a unit string is a scaling-factor error.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (lit : String) (v : ℚ) (i : Bool) (ts : List Esm.Units.Tok), v ≠ 1 → Esm.Units.parse (.num lit v i :: ts) = .error (.scalingFactor lit)

properties.statement: A numeric atom other than 1 after a chain of terms and `*` or `/` is a scaling-factor error ((m/s)^-1/3 reads as ((m/s)^-1)/3).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (a : String) (ops : List (Esm.Units.Op × String)) (op : Esm.Units.Tok) (lit : String) (v : ℚ) (i : Bool) (rest : List Esm.Units.Tok), (op = .star ∨ op = .slash) → v ≠ 1 → Esm.Units.parse (.sym a :: Esm.Units.opToks ops ++ op :: .num lit v i :: rest) = .error (.scalingFactor lit)

properties.statement: `-` is not an operator: a `-` after any chain of terms is a parse error.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (a : String) (ops : List (Esm.Units.Op × String)) (rest : List Esm.Units.Tok), ∃ err, Esm.Units.parse (.sym a :: Esm.Units.opToks ops ++ .minus :: rest) = .error err

properties.statement: At the string level, a-b never resolves for symbol runs a and b (g/hp-hr does not resolve).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ a b : List Char, Esm.Units.IdentRun a → Esm.Units.IdentRun b → ¬ ∃ u, Esm.Units.resolveChars (a ++ '-' :: b) = .ok u

properties.statement: Whitespace between terms is multiplication: `a b` resolves exactly as `a*b` for any two symbol runs.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ a b : List Char, Esm.Units.IdentRun a → Esm.Units.IdentRun b → Esm.Units.resolveChars (a ++ ' ' :: b) = Esm.Units.resolveChars (a ++ '*' :: b)

properties.statement: A symbol is a maximal run delimited by character class, so a digit run joined to a symbol (s1, kgm, cm3) is one token; the alternative reading (longest table-key prefix, so s1 = s·1 and kgm = kg·m) is pending.
